To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the motility parameters of the motor protein OSM-3 are strongly affected by (self-)crowding, while the motility parameters for kinesin-II are not.
the motility of kinesin motors in cilia depends strongly on motor crowding and the crowding of kinesin-III motors is much less affected than that of kinesin-I motors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the collective dynamics of molecular motors and their cargoes.
the collective dynamics of molecular motors in the context of the IFT system in the cilia of C. eleganas.
the dynamics of motor-driven cargo transport in the context of a complex cellular environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the kinesin-II motor density is higher than OSM-2 and the kinesin-1 motor density, but lower than the OSM-3 motor density in cilia.
OSM-3 is the dominant kinesin-II motor in IFT and that it is the main driving force of cargo movement.

the crowding effects on OSM-3 are stronger than on kinesin-II due to the higher motility parameters of the former, but the crowding effect on the collective motility is less strong for the heterotrimeric motor kinesin-II compared with the homodimeric motor OSM-3 due to a higher average run length of the heterotrimer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the two motors are complementary in their response to crowding: OSM-3 is more sensitive to crowding, but kinesin-II can operate more efficiently at higher motor densities.
OSM-3 is a processive motor, which is strongly affected by crowding.
kinesin motors can be classified into two groups: the fast and processive motors, such as kinesin-5 and OSM-3; and the slow and less process motors, such as dynein and kinesin-3.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, while OSM-3 is a highly cooperative motor, kinesin II is not.
OSM-3 is a highly efficient motor that can move fast and far, but is sensitive to the presence of many motors in its vicinity.
kinesin-III, which is a slow and less cooperative motor, is less sensitive to crowding than Osm-3.
